hints.title: Subproblem Recurrence
hints.text: The minimal cost to step onto stair i depends on the minimum between stepping from stair i-1 or stair i-2.

hints.title: Base State Initialization
hints.text: Initialize the first two stair costs directly from cost[0] and cost[1].

hints.title: Constant Space Memory
hints.text: Maintain only the two most recent values during the linear transition.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: 1D recurrence optimized to two rolling scalar variables.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursion without memoization takes O(2^N) exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) rolling variables eliminate array allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Optimize space from O(N) to O(1) using rolling variables.
